name: media-planner
description: Skills for media planners: brief, plan, audit and present paid media from the real business outcome. Google, Meta and 7 more ad platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Brief, plan, audit and present paid media
interface.longDescription: The way a senior media planner works: find the real outcome the business needs, plan or audit the account against it, and present what to do first in a few lines. Pages for Google, Meta, TikTok, Apple, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Pinterest and ChatGPT ads. Works from exported reports or any live connection.
defaultPrompt: Write the brief for this client: what the business really needs from paid media
Audit this ad account against what the business needs and rank the findings by money at stake
